changelog: Voice bullet lists — say "bullet point" alone while dictating (or "বুলেট পয়েন্ট") and a new line with a bullet starts, so a WhatsApp list can be dictated item by item; with Spoken punctuation ON, "bullet point" / "bullet sign" / "check mark sign" / "cross mark sign" / "star sign" (or "বুলেট পয়েন্ট" / "বুলেট চিহ্ন" / "টিক চিহ্ন" / "ক্রস চিহ্ন" / "তারা চিহ্ন") also work mid-sentence and • ✓ ✗ ★ appear in your text — e.g. "items bullet point rice bullet point dal" puts • rice and • dal on new lines. The item after a bullet is capitalized automatically. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message or deletes text you typed.
